The name Erlina is derived from the Old German words ‘er’ meaning ‘earth’ or ‘soil’ and ‘lina’ meaning ‘soft’ or ‘tender’. This name evokes images of a gentle and nurturing spirit, much like a mountain that provides a stable foundation and shelter.
